GALLERY RECORD TERMINAL A
STRATEGIC COMMAND ORDER<New>Space-program magazines
01-08 are transferred to
military authority.<New>Remove instrument mounts.
Install missile cradles,
armored control links, and
payload locks.<New>The launch network will now
carry strategic missiles.
All exploration launches
are suspended.<New><Elly>
"They made the road itself
serve the weapons."<New><Citan>
"The rail did not change.
Only its purpose and those
who commanded it changed."<New><Citan>
"The far bulkhead leads
through the remaining
magazines. Central Control
lies beyond them."<Close>
